description: Short anime-style episodes with recurring characters, their own voices and subtitles.
A cartoon cast works out one small everyday puzzle, each with their own voice, and ends on a cliffhanger.
Original horror stories told by a calm narrator over moody illustrated scenes.
One story per video, such as a battle, an odd law or a forgotten machine, over painted documentary scenes.
Maps of battles and campaigns, with borders, troop movements and labels, narrated over the map.
Thin hand-drawn stick figures act out the answer to one curious question on a sheet of paper.
One hypothetical per video, told with flat-vector cartoon characters over painted places.
Narrated stick-figure films that answer one curious everyday question each.
